top_story: Washington and Tehran have moved from March’s open brinkmanship over the Strait of Hormuz to a June memorandum that would reopen maritime traffic, free blocked Iranian assets, and keep wider negotiations alive, signaling a tactical de-escalation despite fierce opposition in both capitals.
